title: Florida court overturns fraud findings in $34.7m tobacco death case, orders new damages trial
summary_full: In a significant development, Frances Bessent-Dixon's lawsuit against R.J. Reynolds was impacted by a recent court ruling. The appeals court dismissed the prior jury's fraud verdict, necessitating a new trial focused on damages. Tyrone M. Dixon, Bessent-Dixon's late husband, passed away from throat cancer caused by smoking, with R.J. Reynolds asserting that he was aware of the dangers of tobacco.
